title: Paper Packaging Business Equity Stake For Sale in Bhiwandi, India
tagline: Corrugated box manufacturing business in Bhiwandi, backed by over 20 years of industry experience in the packaging sector. - The promoter has established industry relationships and a client network in Bhiwandi, a key logistics hub, providing a foundation for restarting operations. - The business manufactured 3-ply and 5-ply corrugated boxes, custom packaging solutions and corrugated sheets for e-commerce, logistics and manufacturing clients. - When operational, the business had a production capacity of approximately 3 tonnes per day and operated with a team of 10 employees. - The business is currently non-operational, having stopped operations a few months ago. The existing machinery is currently stored at the promoter's residence.
